content.title: Hornets Game Against Suns To Be Broadcast On Peacock | Charlotte Hornets
content.text: Hornets Game Against Suns To Be Broadcast On PeacockTime Changed to 10:00 p.m. ET for March 8 Game at PhoenixHornets PRFebruary 20, 202610:55 PM ESTFebruary 20, 2026 – The NBA announced today that the start time for the Charlotte Hornets game at Phoenix on Sunday, March 8 has been changed to 10:00 p.m. ET and will be exclusively broadcast on Peacock. The game will also be broadcast on the team’s flagship radio station, WFNZ (92.7 FM).The contest will mark the Hornets’ fifth national television game this season, and the second nationally televised game to be added to the team’s schedule in the last seven days following the March 14 contest at San Antonio (3:30 p.m.) being rescheduled to NBA on Prime.Charlotte heads into tonight’s matchup with Cleveland winners of 10 of its last 12 games. The Hornets are tied for the second-most wins in the NBA since Jan. 1 with 15 total wins and hold the second-best net rating of +9.1 over that time. Hornets Head Coach Charles Lee is the reigning Eastern Conference Coach of the Month and rookie forward Kon Kneuppel is the three-time reigning Kia Eastern Conference Rookie of the Month.For more information regarding Hornets single-game tickets and 2026-27 season memberships, please visit hornets.com.TagsFeaturedPress Release tickets@hornets.com 704-HORNETS Chat With Us open chat Your Privacy ChoicesWe use cookies and other tracking technologies on our online services.
